prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a corrected FOUR-frame walking cycle sprite atlas for the character in the supplied identity reference. The reference is an older atlas: keep exactly the same character identity, face, clothes, equipment, species, colors and rendering style. Replace ONLY the motion concept; output ONLY walking poses, not idle, attack, or defeat. Square RGBA PNG, true transparent background. EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows, one entire character per equal cell, all feet at the same ground baseline, all heads same size, fixed camera, 12% empty transparent margin around each character. All four figures face and travel SCREEN RIGHT in a clear right-facing three-quarter side view. The pelvis and shoulders stay centered. Read order top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. Pose 1: LEFT foot far forward to screen right, heel touches ground, RIGHT foot far behind to screen left, toe on ground. Pose 2: LEFT leg supports the body beneath hip, RIGHT knee bends visibly and right foot lifts forward past the supporting leg. Pose 3: RIGHT foot far forward to screen right, heel touches ground, LEFT foot far behind to screen left, toe on ground. Pose 4: RIGHT leg supports body beneath hip, LEFT knee bends visibly and left foot lifts forward past supporting leg. The two legs MUST trade their front/back roles; do NOT repeat the same extended leg in every frame. Clear knee bends and alternating planted/lifted feet, cloak responds subtly. Weapon carried still, no attacks or arm gestures. Make the near leg clearly switch: in poses 1 and 2 it is FORWARD, in poses 3 and 4 it is BEHIND the hip. The farther leg has darker natural shading. In pose 4 the NEAR foot bends BACKWARD under the rump while the FAR leg is planted. Match the reference hand-painted storybook outlines and palette. No scene, floor, shadows, letters, grid, text, particles, duplicate poses, cropping, or background colour. This will be played cyclically 1-2-3-4-1 to depict actual walking.
Subject specifics: Teal troll spearman with orange mohawk, ivory tusks, leather shoulder armor, moss ragged skirt, spear carried diagonally and spare spears over the shoulder.
processing: Original generated RGBA file copied unchanged; cropping and pivot only in UE sprite metadata.
